description:
The proposal involves replacing all existing deteriorated single-glazed timber windows at 5, 7 and 9 Dorset Road. Front elevation windows will be replaced with slimline double‑glazed timber units to match the existing appearance. Rear elevation sash and casement windows will be replaced with double‑glazed uPVC vertical sliding and casement units to improve thermal performance, security and resident comfort.

The works also include replacing the existing pitched natural slate roof covering with new natural Welsh slate, maintaining the existing roof profile and appearance, and carrying out associated repairs to chimneys, soffits and rainwater goods. This will address water ingress risks, improve durability and weatherproofing, and preserve the building’s character within the Clyde Circus Conservation Area.
